race.comment: Hard to knock the consistency of LUVBITE (3) who added to a series of top-two finishes when coming from a big 80m handicap for second last time. Won twice in a row here prior. Switches back to a mobile start but draws well and his strike rate at this distance stands at 50 per cent. ALTA TRIBUTE (12) did a good job from this same barrier last week, working but sticking on for second. With a little better fortune he could go one better. PENNY BLACK NZ (7) is an accomplished mare who is building in fitness and could be ready to strike after placing in her last two outings here. BEACH DIAMOND (4) has yet to find her best since arriving in WA but she may be better for those outings. Improvement would not surprise.
